summary: Inside the hotel, Trinity paces while on the phone; when the call connects she reaches an Operator who puts Morpheus through. She reports that the line was traced, and Morpheus confirms the Agents cut the hardline so this line is not a viable exit. She asks if there are Agents; he says yes, and she swears in frustration. Morpheus tells her to focus and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, saying she can make it. She takes a deep breath to center herself, agrees, and on his command 'Go' she drops the phone.

what_changes.before: Believes only that her line was traced and does not know how.
what_changes.after: Learns from Morpheus that the Agents cut the hardline and that this line is not a viable exit, so she must reach another phone.
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY / Morpheus!  The line was traced!  I / don't know how. ... MORPHEUS (MANV.O.) / I know.  They cut the hardline. / This line is not a viable exit.

what_changes.before: Panicked and swearing after learning Agents are present.
what_changes.after: Centered and ready to act once Morpheus gives her a target and tells her to go.
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY / Goddamnit! ... She takes a deep breath, centering herself. / TRINITY / All right --

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus guides a cornered Trinity by phone toward an exit phone at Wells and Lake while Agents close in.
